{{Quote|Outta the way, swamp-man.|The Gotal, nearly colliding with Jar Jar Binks on a Coruscant street|<ref name="AttR" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="date">The events of ''[[Anakin to the Rescue]]'' occur while the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] debates whether [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] will be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', those events occurred in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> a '''Gotal''' was riding a [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] down a street on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] ran into the street without looking for oncoming traffic, the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] narrowly avoided a collision with the Gungan. The [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] bike rider yelled angrily at Binks to get out of the thoroughfare. The Gotal, who had shaggy, brown [[Hair/Legends|fur]], light brown skin, black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and long, brown claws, was considered ugly by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], Binks's [[Human/Legends|Human]] companion, who had opted to stay on the sidewalk. The Gotal wore olive-green trousers, brown and black [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a fuzzy, black collar with white trim.<ref name="AttR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gotal appears in the [[1999]] childrens' book ''[[Anakin to the Rescue]]'', written by [[Cecilia Venn]] and illustrated by [[Chris Trevas]].<ref name="AttR" />
